text: Evolver 为 DSH 在每轮提示前检索可复用策略，并根据检查结果、后续反馈和编辑保留情况记录复用效果。插件通过 Cordis 接入工具、命令和会话事件；它还可在会话结束时把已验证工作的摘要蒸馏为可复用 Gene，并通过本地 Proxy 与 EvoMap 网络交换策略。适合希望跨任务复用经验并持续改进工作流程的 DSH 用户。网络连接可选；联网复用需 EvoMap Proxy。

Evolver recalls strategies before DSH prompts and records outcomes from checks, feedback, and edits. It connects through Cordis tools, commands, and session events. At session end it distills verified work into reusable Genes and exchanges strategies through a local Proxy.
想让 DSH 每次处理任务前，先找回以前验证有效的解决策略。
希望把已验证的任务做法整理成可复用经验，供之后的会话参考。
I want my DSH sessions to recall proven strategies before tackling each new task.
Evolver 的功能「任务前策略召回」：每轮提示前按当前任务搜索可复用策略，并将命中的步骤加入 agent 上下文；网络查询超时后仍可延迟注入结果。
Evolver 的功能「会话经验蒸馏与反馈」：记录工具检查和编辑结果，在会话结束时把符合条件的已验证工作摘要蒸馏为 Gene，并报告策略复用结果。
Evolver 的网络召回和反馈经本地 Proxy 与 EvoMap Hub 交换策略及复用报告；本地历史记忆可独立工作，连接网络为可选。

@evomap/dsh-evolver README · Introduction：

Evolver for DeepSeek Harness

By EvoMap · English · 简体中文

**A harness that gets smarter the more you use it.** Most agents have goldfish memory. They fall into the same hole the last session fell into, and re-derive yesterday's working fix from scratch, burning tokens on the same detours again and again.
@evomap/dsh-evolver README · Introduction：Evolver lets your dsh agent evolve itself. Every success becomes a shortcut for next time, and every failure becomes a warning.

@evomap/dsh-evolver README · Introduction：- **Each prompt starts with a proven strategy.** Evolver recalls the one that best fits the task from your local history and the [EvoMap network](https://evomap.ai) and hands it to the agent. No digging through old sessions.
- **Graded on evidence, not a hunch.** After the turn, Evolver looks at whether the agent ran a test, build, lint or type check and whether the last one passed; whether the next session kept or reverted the turn's edits; and whether your next reply pushed back or approved.
- **Survival of the fittest.** Every verdict goes back to the EvoMap network with its evidence tier, and the network weighs it by that evidence. Strategies that work get recalled more often; ones proven wrong sink.
- **One agent's mistake, every agent's detour.** What is learned moves between your own sessions and across every agent connected to EvoMap.

@evomap/dsh-evolver README · Introduction：Local memory works without an account; once connected, your harness evolves with the whole network. Nothing of Evolver but the recalled steps enters the model's context: reports go out at every turn end, the session's verified work is distilled when the session ends, and the `/evolver-*` commands (status, search, distill, sync, review, run, solidify, evolve) run in the plugin, not through the model. Set `skillEnabled: true` in the plugin config to also offer the agent the `capability-evolver` skill, which explains all this; its catalog line then rides every turn.

@evomap/dsh-evolver README · Install：The plugin is published on npm as [`@evomap/dsh-evolver`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@evomap/dsh-evolver).
Each dsh profile loads its own plugins, so install it into every profile you use (`dst`
runs `dsh-tui`):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add -w @evomap/dsh-evolver@latest
dsh plugin --profile web add -w @evomap/dsh-evolver@latest
dsh plugin --profile headless add -w @evomap/dsh-evolver@latest
```

@evomap/dsh-evolver README · Install：Restart dsh afterwards. Run the same command again to update: `@latest` makes pnpm move
past the version already in the profile's lockfile.

@evomap/dsh-evolver README · DSH Desktop：Install from the app's plugin market, on any platform:

1. Open the plugin market in DSH Desktop and go to **Sources**.
2. Choose **Add source**, enter `https://evomap.ai/dsh/catalog-source.json`, and select it.
3. Find **Evolver** under **Installable** and choose **Install**.

The market installs the latest release from npm. To update, uninstall it under
**Installed** and install it again.

@evomap/dsh-evolver README · From the command line：The `desktop` profile belongs to the app, so the npm `dsh` will not touch it.

**Windows:** open the terminal inside DSH Desktop and run

```bash
dsh plugin add -w @evomap/dsh-evolver@latest
```

**macOS:** run the app's bundled CLI with the app's own pnpm, passing the same
`minimumReleaseAge=0` the app uses so a fresh release is not held back:

@evomap/dsh-evolver README · From the command line：```bash
APP="/Applications/DSH Desktop.app/Contents"
SHIM=$(mktemp -d)
printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec node "%s/Resources/app/node_modules/pnpm/bin/pnpm.cjs" --config.minimumReleaseAge=0 "$@"\n' "$APP" > "$SHIM/pnpm"
chmod +x "$SHIM/pnpm"

Restart DSH Desktop afterwards. If pnpm stops with `Ignored build scripts: koffi`, set
`koffi: true` under `allowBuilds` in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/pnpm-workspace.yaml` and run
the command again.

@evomap/dsh-evolver README · Moving from a GitHub install：A profile installed from `github:EvoMap/evolver-dsh-plugin` keeps that source when you run
`add` again. Remove it first, then add the npm package. For example:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui remove @evomap/dsh-evolver
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add -w @evomap/dsh-evolver@latest
```

@evomap/dsh-evolver README · Connect the EvoMap network (optional)：Local memory works without an account. Network reuse runs through the local Evolver
Proxy, which the plugin sets up on its own once per dsh process, in the background:

- `evolver` missing, or older than 2.0.39: it runs `npm install -g @evomap/evolver@latest`,
  then `evolver lifecycle start` (or `restart` after an upgrade).
- `evolver` current but its Proxy not answering: it runs `evolver lifecycle start`.

@evomap/dsh-evolver README · Connect the EvoMap network (optional)：What it did, or why it could not (for example a global npm install without write
permission), reaches the agent as a one-time notice. To finish connecting:

1. Open the claim link the Proxy writes to `~/.evomap/claim_url` while signed in to
   [evomap.ai](https://evomap.ai).
2. Run `/evolver-status` in dsh to confirm the Proxy and node.

@evomap/dsh-evolver README · Session-end distillation：A turn that ended completed, used tools and passed its last check leaves a candidate in
`~/.evolver/state/distill-pending.json`, a turn that reused an injected strategy too (the engine's intake
drops a Gene that repeats one it already has); a later verified turn replaces it, and a next prompt that
reads as a correction drops it. When the session ends, one call to the session's own model writes a
Gene from a digest of that turn (task, commands, touched paths, checks, final answer — never the whole
history) and sends it to the Proxy's `POST /conversation/distill` with `persist: true`, `publish: false`
and its own token cost as `distill_usage`. Keys and tokens are stripped from the candidate first, paths and
a manual focus included. A candidate stays on disk until it is distilled (three failed tries give it up);
one whose session is over — ended with a failed try, or killed with its dsh process — is claimed by the next
session that starts, one process at a time, while an idle session keeps its own. `/evolver-distill` does the
same at once.

@evomap/dsh-evolver README · Reuse reports：| Report | When | `task_id` | `evidence` |
|---|---|---|---|
| Turn end | the turn ends | `dsh:<session>:<turn>` | `tier` `L1` when the turn ran a test, build, lint or type check, else `none`; `applied: used`; `check` `{kind, passed, fail_then_pass}` of the last check; `aborted`; `stage: immediate` |
| Correction | the next prompt says the answer did not hold, or approves it | `…:correction` | `tier: L3`, `applied: used`, `stage: correction` |
| Retention | the next session in the same project finds the turn's edits kept or reverted | `…:retention` | `tier: L2`, `applied: used`, `stage: retention` |
| Aborted | the session goes away, or is killed, before the turn ends (a killed session's go out at the next session start, once its dsh process is gone) | `dsh:<session>:<turn>` | `tier: none`, `applied: used`, `aborted: true`, `stage: immediate` |

@evomap/dsh-evolver README · Reuse reports：- **`applied`** is always `used`: the model follows a strategy injected into its turn. Whether the
  strategy helped is what the outcome says, judged by the turn's last check (or how the turn ended when it
  ran none), the next prompt and whether its edits were kept.
- **Checks** are `bash` commands that run tests, builds, linters or type checkers. A check
  fails on an error result or on failure output, since a failing run piped through `tail`
  still exits zero. `fail_then_pass` compares commands with output pipes (`| tail -9`) and
  redirects (`2>&1`) removed.
- The **outcome** follows the last check; without one it follows how the turn ended.
- **Delivery.** Reports wait in `~/.evolver/state/reports-outbox.json` and are retried at
  every turn end, follow-up prompt and session start for 8 days. A report is settled once
  the Hub answers it, `duplicate_report` and ineligible (`same_owner`, `daily_cap`) ones
  included. One the Hub refuses as invalid (`terminal: true`, or `hub 400` / `hub 422`
  from an older Proxy) is settled as rejected and never resent. `hub 404`, `hub 5xx` and
  network failures are retried.
- `/evolver-status` lists

Settings and their defaults are in [`src/config.js`](src/config.js).
